_comment: Names suggested by Claude (tools/llm_names.py), applied by ApplyFacts after the RTTI names and before data/names.json, whose hand names win. Not reviewed one by one: confidence and evidence say how far to trust each. Move an entry to names.json once checked.

0x401000.name: DragEnter
0x401000.evidence: (medium) Args (this, dataObj, keyState, pt.x, pt.y, pdwEffect) match IDropTarget::DragEnter. Stores dataObj @0x8, zeroes *effect, calls the callback @0xc with (dataObj, pt, ctx @0x10) and sets the effect to 1 when it returns true.

0x401040.name: DragOver
0x401040.evidence: (medium) Args (this, keyState, pt.x, pt.y, pdwEffect) match IDropTarget::DragOver. Zeroes *effect, calls the callback @0x14 with (stored dataObj @8, pt, ctx @0x18) and sets the effect to 1 on true.

0x401080.name: DragLeave
0x401080.evidence: (medium) Calls the callback @0x1c with ctx @0x20 when it is set; returns 0 (S_OK).

0x4010a0.name: Drop
0x4010a0.evidence: (medium) Args (this, dataObj, keyState, pt.x, pt.y, effect) match IDropTarget::Drop. Calls the callback @0x24 with (dataObj, pt, ctx @0x28).

0x401170.name: AddRef
0x401170.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 1: increments the refcount @4 and returns the new count.

0x401190.name: Release
0x401190.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 2: decrements the refcount @4. At zero it calls the deleting destructor (slot 7) with flag 1 and returns 0.

0x4011b0.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x4011b0.evidence: (high) Resets the vftable to ComBase<IDropTarget> and calls operator delete (0x406ad0) when bit 0 of the flag is set.

0x4011f0.name: GuidEquals
0x4011f0.evidence: (high) Compares two 16-byte blocks in 4-byte steps and returns 1 when they are equal. QueryInterface uses it to compare against the IID constants.

0x401260.name: QueryInterface
0x401260.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 0: checks the riid against the two GUIDs @0x1082374 and @0x1082344. On a match it returns this with AddRef; otherwise *ppv = 0 and it returns 0x80004002 (E_NOINTERFACE).

0x401320.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x401320.evidence: (medium) Sets the ComBase<IDropTarget> vftable and calls operator delete when flag bit 0 is set; a second copy of the deleting destructor.

0x401360.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x401360.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 0: sets the vftable and calls operator delete when flag bit 0 is set.

0x4015a0.name: Equals
0x4015a0.evidence: (medium) Returns 1 when the two u32s @0 and @4 equal the argument's two u32s; a 64-bit id equality operator.

0x4015d0.name: NotEquals
0x4015d0.evidence: (medium) Returns 0 when both u32s @0/@4 match the argument's, else 1.

0x401640.name: CloseHandleRef
0x401640.evidence: (high) If *p is a handle, calls CloseHandle on it and zeroes *p.

0x401660.name: MutexExists
0x401660.evidence: (high) OpenMutexA(0x1f0001 = MUTEX_ALL_ACCESS, 0, name). If that succeeds it closes the handle and returns 1, else 0.

0x401690.name: Close
0x401690.evidence: (medium) Calls CloseHandle on the handle @0 and zeroes it.

0x4016b0.name: CreateUnique
0x4016b0.evidence: (high) Closes the old handle, then CreateMutexA(name). If GetLastError is 0xb7 (ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) it releases and closes the handle. Returns whether a handle remains.

0x401710.name: GetGameMutexName
0x401710.evidence: (high) Lazily wsprintfA's "Global\\6AA83AB5-..._ffxiv_game%02d" into a 0x100-byte slot @0x1370190[index] and returns it.

0x401740.name: SystemConfig
0x401740.evidence: (high) Constructor: calls the base constructor 0x421920, then sets the SystemConfig vftable.

0x401770.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x401770.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 0: calls the destructor 0x4219f0, then operator delete when flag bit 0 is set.

0x4017a0.name: DevConfig
0x4017a0.evidence: (high) Constructor: calls the base constructor 0x421a50, then sets the DevConfig vftable.

0x4017d0.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x4017d0.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 0: calls the destructor 0x421a70, then operator delete when flag bit 0 is set.

0x401810.name: RegisterPrintScreenHotKey
0x401810.evidence: (high) Calls RegisterHotKey(main hwnd @0x136fb14, id, modifiers, 0x2c = VK_SNAPSHOT), trying ids from the counter @0x136fc00 up to 0xbffe. Stores the id it got in *this and advances the counter.

0x401900.name: BytesToHex
0x401900.evidence: (medium) For each of count bytes, _sprintf_s's the two nibbles into 2 output chars using the format @0x108028c.

0x401960.name: AppendTraceLine
0x401960.evidence: (medium) vsprintf_s's the format into 1024 bytes, appends the suffix string @0x1080294, then strcat_s's the result into the 0x4000-byte buffer at this+4.

0x4019e0.name: CreateMainWindow
0x4019e0.evidence: (high) Called by WinMain. AdjustWindowRect on the size @0x136fae0/e4 with the style @0x12fd1f8, then CreateWindowExA centred on the screen using the class @0x136fb18 and title @0x136fb80. Stores the hwnd @0x136fb14 and the client origin and size.

0x401b30.name: GetWStringData
0x401b30.evidence: (medium) Returns the heap pointer @0 when the capacity @0x14 is > 7, else the inline buffer; an MSVC std::wstring data accessor.

0x401d20.name: GetMutexName
0x401d20.evidence: (high) If the flag is set, returns the lazily formatted "Global\\..._ffxiv_game%02d" name for the index. Otherwise returns the static name pointer @0x12fa5a0[index].

0x401d80.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0x401d80.evidence: (medium) Sets the TraceCallbackInterface vftable and calls operator delete when flag bit 0 is set; a derived class's copy.

0x401db0.name: OnTraceLine
0x401db0.evidence: (medium) Formats its argument with the format @0x1080530 into 1024 bytes, strcat_s's it into the 0x4000-byte buffer at this+4 and returns 1.

0x401e10.name: PumpWindowMessages
0x401e10.evidence: (high) PeekMessageW loop, up to 10 messages, with TranslateAcceleratorA/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageW. VK_PROCESSKEY (0xe5) is remapped via ImmGetVirtualKey; WM_QUIT (0x12) calls 0x4246b0(app,0). Then, unless app@10 is set, it calls slot 2 of DAT_0136fb0c and the app's slot 4, and Sleep(0); called by WinMain.

0x401f50.name: SizeMoveTimerProc
0x401f50.evidence: (medium) Passed to SetTimer(hwnd,1,0x21,...) by the window procedure on WM_ENTERSIZEMOVE/WM_ENTERMENULOOP. Calls 0x4298f0 and, if that returns 0, PumpWindowMessages.

0x401fc0.name: WStringFindLastOf
0x401fc0.evidence: (high) wstring find_last_of(chars, pos, count): scans backwards from min(pos, size-1) for any of the count chars and returns the index or 0xffffffff; uses SSO at capacity@0x14 < 8.

0x402080.name: WStringSetLength
0x402080.evidence: (high) Sets size@0x10 = n and writes a 0 wchar at buffer[n].

0x4020a0.name: WStringErase
0x4020a0.evidence: (high) Throws "invalid string position" if pos > size; moves the tail down over min(count, size-pos) chars, shrinks size@0x10 and terminates the buffer.

0x402130.name: WStringContainsPointer
0x402130.evidence: (high) Returns 1 when the non-null pointer lies within [buffer, buffer+size*2), else 0.

0x402190.name: IsGameInstanceMutexPresent
0x402190.evidence: (high) Picks the name from the table @0x12fa5a0, or formats "Global\\6AA83AB5-...-A309770760CB_ffxiv_game%02d" into the buffer @0x1370190+idx*0x100. OpenMutexA(0x1f0001) on it; if that succeeds it closes the handle and returns 1.

0x4021f0.name: CreateGameInstanceMutex
0x4021f0.evidence: (high) Same name selection as IsGameInstanceMutexPresent; closes any old handle @0 and CreateMutexA into @0. On ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS (0xb7) it releases and closes the handle; returns whether the handle @0 is non-null.

0x402290.name: CreateNamedGlobalMutex
0x402290.evidence: (medium) CreateMutexA(NULL,0,name) with the name from the table @0x12fa5a0[idx]; the handle is discarded.

0x402730.name: MainWndProc
0x402730.evidence: (high) Set as lpfnWndProc by the class registration at 0x4032a0. Handles WM_CREATE (LoadImageA of cursors), WM_DESTROY (PostQuitMessage), WM_SIZE, WM_ACTIVATE, WM_PAINT (ValidateRect), WM_GETMINMAXINFO, enter/exit size-move timers, WM_NCLBUTTONDOWN and WM_SYSCOMMAND filtering; ends with DefWindowProcA.

0x403150.name: WStringFindLastOfCStr
0x403150.evidence: (high) Measures the zero-terminated wide string and calls WStringFindLastOf(this, s, pos, len).

0x403180.name: WStringTidy
0x403180.evidence: (high) If built and capacity > 7, copies the first n chars back into the SSO buffer and frees the heap block (0x429760, tag 0x3d); sets size=n, capacity=7 and terminates.

0x4031e0.name: WStringReallocate
0x4031e0.evidence: (high) Computes the new capacity (n|7, or grows by 1.5x), allocates (cap*2+2) via 0x4296a0 and copies the old n chars. Frees the old heap buffer and sets ptr@0, capacity@0x14, size@0x10, then terminates.

0x4032a0.name: RegisterMainWindowClass
0x4032a0.evidence: (high) RegisterClassExA with style 3, WndProc 0x402730, icon 0x99, IDC_ARROW, BLACK_BRUSH, menu 0x6d and the class name @0x136fb18; called by WinMain with hInstance.

0x403330.name: WStringRelease
0x403330.evidence: (high) Frees the heap buffer when capacity > 7, then resets capacity to 7, size to 0 and the first char to 0; called by GetMyDocumentsPath on its temporaries.

0x403370.name: WStringGrow
0x403370.evidence: (high) Throws "string too long" for -1. Reallocates when n > capacity; when trimming and n < 8, moves the data back to SSO; for n == 0 empties the string. Returns n != 0.

0x403430.name: WStringAssignSubstring
0x403430.evidence: (high) Assigns (other, pos, count): checks the position and handles self-assign with two erases. Otherwise grows and memcpy's min(count, size-pos) chars, then terminates.

0x403530.name: WStringAssignChars
0x403530.evidence: (high) Assigns (ptr, count): when ptr points inside the string, delegates to WStringAssignSubstring; otherwise grows and memcpy's count chars, then terminates.

0x403640.name: WStringConstructSubstring
0x403640.evidence: (high) Initialises an empty SSO string (capacity 7, size 0), then WStringAssignSubstring(other, pos, count).

0x403680.name: WStringAssignCStr
0x403680.evidence: (high) Measures the wide C string and calls WStringAssignChars.

0x4036d0.name: WStringConstructCStr
0x4036d0.evidence: (high) Initialises an empty SSO string, then assigns the zero-terminated wide string; GetMyDocumentsPath uses it.

0x403720.name: WStringSubstr
0x403720.evidence: (high) Constructs the destination (param_1) empty, then assigns this string's (pos, count) into it; returns the destination.

0x403760.name: WStringMoveAssign
0x403760.evidence: (high) If not self: frees its own buffer, then takes the source's heap pointer or copies its SSO buffer, along with size and capacity. Resets the source to empty.

0x403800.name: BuildExeVersionString
0x403800.evidence: (high) GetModuleFileNameW; reads the file in 0x400-byte chunks through a hash (init 0x408e90, update 0x40b110, final 0x40b090 to 20 bytes). Takes the filename after the last path separator and appends it, "/", the file size and "/" plus 40 hex digits to this.

0x403e80.name: ~RootTask
0x403e80.evidence: (medium) Destroys the members at +0x28 and +0 with 0x4a05c0; RootTask's vf0 does the same per element.

0x403ea0.name: VectorDeletingDestructor
0x403ea0.evidence: (high) With flag bit 1 set it reads the element count at [-1] and destroys each 0x294-byte element (FUN_004a47c0) in reverse, then frees the block from count-1 when bit 0 is set. Otherwise it destroys one object and frees it if bit 0 is set.

0x403f20.name: VectorDeletingDestructor
0x403f20.evidence: (high) Slot 0: with flag bit 1, destroys count@-4 elements of 0x58 bytes (members +0x28 and +0) and frees via 0x406b30. Otherwise destroys one object and frees via 0x406ad0 when bit 0 is set.

0x404590.name: Allocate
0x404590.evidence: (medium) Gets the allocator through its own slot 4 and calls the allocator's slot 3 with (this, param_1, max(param_2, @8)), so @8 acts as a minimum alignment.

0x404650.name: DestroyAllSpaces
0x404650.evidence: (medium) Walks the list @4 (next = node[9]-8), calls each node's scalar deleting destructor with 1, then clears @4.

0x404710.name: Free
0x404710.evidence: (medium) Calls the allocator's slot 7 (+0x1c) with the pointer and returns 0. RegularAllocator uses slot 7 to free a space's memory.

0x404730.name: GetBlockSize
0x404730.evidence: (medium) Forwards to the allocator's slot 8, which in RegularAllocator returns the block header @-0xc & 0x7fffffff.

0x4047e0.name: InitFreeList
0x4047e0.evidence: (medium) Links param_3 blocks of size param_2 starting at param_1 into a doubly linked list (prev @0, next @4), stores the head @0x14 and zeroes the last block's next pointer.

0x404840.name: PushFreeBlock
0x404840.evidence: (medium) Inserts the block after the free-list head @0x14 (or makes it the head when the list is empty) and decrements the count @0.

0x4048a0.name: GetFreeSize
0x4048a0.evidence: (medium) Returns (@0x14 - @4) * @0x10: block count minus used count, times the block size.

0x4048d0.name: AllocateAligned
0x4048d0.evidence: (medium) Calls its own slot 3 with (p1, p2) and ignores the third argument.

0x4048f0.name: Allocate
0x4048f0.evidence: (high) Pops the free-list head @0x18 and increments the used count @4. Returns the node + 0x17 rounded down to 16, storing the node at ret-8 and this at ret-4.

0x404930.name: Free
0x404930.evidence: (high) Under the lock of the allocator @0x20 (its slots 2 and 3), puts the node at ptr-8 back on the free list @0x18 and decrements @4. When @4 reaches 0 and the allocator's slot 12 returns true, it calls its own slot 1.

0x4049b0.name: GetBlockSize
0x4049b0.evidence: (medium) Returns the fixed block size @0x10 whatever the pointer.

0x4049c0.name: ReleaseAllSpaces
0x4049c0.evidence: (medium) For each of the @0x18 pools, destroys every space in the list @0x1c+i*4 (next @0x2c) and the cached space @0x6c+i*4. Each goes through vtable slot 0 with 0, and its memory @8 is freed through this's slot 7.

0x404a50.name: Allocate
0x404a50.evidence: (medium) Forwards its three arguments to its own slot 5 with an extra 0 flag.

0x404aa0.name: AlignPayloadAddress
0x404aa0.evidence: (medium) Returns (p + 0x1c + align - 1) & ~(align - 1), skipping the 0x1c-byte block header.

0x404ae0.name: CalcRequiredBlockSize
0x404ae0.evidence: (medium) Returns size + 0x1b + align, the worst-case block size used in RegularAllocator slot 13.

0x404b00.name: FindFreeBlock
0x404b00.evidence: (medium) Walks the free list @0x10 (next @-0x10). Without the flag it returns an exactly fitting aligned block or the smallest larger one; with the flag it returns the highest-address block that is large enough.

0x404be0.name: UnlinkFreeBlock
0x404be0.evidence: (medium) Removes the block from the list headed @0x10, using its prev @-0x14 and next @-0x10.

0x404c70.name: ReleaseSpace
0x404c70.evidence: (medium) Unlinks the space from pool @0x28's list @0x1c+i*4 (next @0x2c). It keeps the space in the cache slot @0x6c+i*4 and returns 0 if that slot is empty, otherwise returns 1.

0x404cd0.name: FindPoolIndex
0x404cd0.evidence: (medium) Returns -1 if the byte @0xbc is set. Otherwise scans the @0x18 16-byte pool entries @0x14 for min(@+4) <= size <= max(@+0) and align <= @+0xc and returns the index, or -1. Called by RegularAllocator::vf5.

0x404d40.name: AllocateEx
0x404d40.evidence: (medium) Forwards to its own slot 4 (Allocate) and drops the flag argument.

0x404d80.name: Reallocate
0x404d80.evidence: (high) vtable slot 6 forwards (ptr, size, alignment) to __aligned_realloc.

0x404da0.name: Free
0x404da0.evidence: (high) vtable slot 7 calls __aligned_free on its pointer.

0x404df0.name: FindFreeBlock
0x404df0.evidence: (medium) vtable slot 13 walks the free list from @0x10 through each block's -0x10 link. It returns the first block whose size (@-4 & 0x7fffffff) is at least size + align + 0x1b, else 0.

0x404e20.name: FindFreeBlock
0x404e20.evidence: (medium) vtable slot 13 has the same body as UIAllocator's: a first-fit search of the free list @0x10 for size + align + 0x1b bytes.

0x404e50.name: AllocateDefault
0x404e50.evidence: (medium) Gets a space from FUN_00406520. With DAT_01370bcc 0 it calls __aligned_malloc(size, align or 0x10); otherwise it calls the space's slot 5 (+0x14) with (size, align, tag).

0x404f50.name: ManagedSpace
0x404f50.evidence: (high) The constructor: sets ManagedSpace's vftable, allocator @4, @8, @0xc and byte @0x10 = 0. It then calls the allocator's slot 1 (init) with (param_2, this, param_3, param_4).

0x404f90.name: FreeBlock
0x404f90.evidence: (medium) Slot 4, under the critical section @8: merges the block with its unused prev (@0x20) and next (@0x24) neighbours, deleting the merged ones through slot 0. It clears the in-use byte @0x1c and recomputes the size @0x10 from the next block's address or the range end (slots 5 and 6).

0x405080.name: GetFreeSize
0x405080.evidence: (high) Slot 7, under the critical section: sums the size @0x10 of every block in the list @4 whose in-use byte @0x1c is 0.

0x4050c0.name: MemorySpace
0x4050c0.evidence: (high) The constructor: sets MemorySpace's vftable, allocator @4, alignment @8, @0xc and byte @0x10 = 0.

0x4050f0.name: InitFixedPool
0x4050f0.evidence: (medium) Splits the buffer (param_1, size param_2) into size/param_3 chunks linked both ways (prev @0, next @4). It stores base @4/@0x14, size @8, chunk size @0xc and count @0x10.

0x405140.name: GetFreeSize
0x405140.evidence: (medium) Slot 11, under the spinlock @0xd8 or the critical section @0xc0: sums the sizes on the free list @0x10. It adds slot 11 (+0x2c) of every fixed space in the lists @0x1c[i] and @0x6c[i] for i < count @0x18.

0x405230.name: InitBlockHeader
0x405230.evidence: (medium) Writes a heap block header before the pointer: links @-0x1c..-0x10 and @-4 set to 0, @-8 = param_2, @-0xc = size & 0x7fffffff.

0x405260.name: CoalesceFreeBlock
0x405260.evidence: (medium) Clears the block's in-use bit and merges it with free physical neighbours, unlinking them from the free list @0x10 of this. It pushes the result at the free list head.

0x405330.name: AllocateInSpace
0x405330.evidence: (medium) With a space argument, calls its slot 5 (+0x14) with (size, align, tag). Otherwise it uses the default path: __aligned_malloc when DAT_01370bcc is 0, else FUN_00406520's space.

0x405390.name: AllocateInSpace2
0x405390.evidence: (medium) An identical copy of 0x405330: the given space's slot 5, otherwise __aligned_malloc or the current space.

0x4053f0.name: CreateManagedSpace
0x4053f0.evidence: (high) Type 0 allocates an 8-byte SystemManagedAllocator; type 1 allocates a 0x2c-byte SeparateManagedAllocator with a critical section. It then builds a 0x14-byte ManagedSpace over it and calls the allocator's slot 1.

0x405540.name: Allocate
0x405540.evidence: (medium) Slot 3: a best-fit search of unused blocks for size and alignment. It splits off a new 0x28-byte ManagedBlock when more than 0x2f bytes remain, then marks the block used (@0x1c = 1, aligned address @8, size @0x14).

0x4056f0.name: FixedPool
0x4056f0.evidence: (medium) The same chunk free-list initialisation as 0x4050f0, returning this; FixedSpace's constructor calls it at +4.

0x405790.name: RegularAllocator
0x405790.evidence: (high) The constructor: sets the vftable and flag bytes @0xbd-0xbf, initialises the critical section @0xc0 and clears the spinlock @0xd8. It stores base @4, size @8, table @0x14 and count @0x18, writes one free block header at the aligned base (@0xc, @0x10) and clears the lists @0x1c and @0x6c.

0x405840.name: Free
0x405840.evidence: (high) Slot 7, under the lock: clears the in-use bit and tag of the block header, then CoalesceFreeBlock(ptr-8).

0x4058d0.name: AllocateFromHeap
0x4058d0.evidence: (medium) Finds a block through slot 13 (+0x34), unlinks it from the free list @0x10 and aligns it (FUN_00404c10). It marks it used and splits the remainder when over 0x4b bytes; with flag set it carves from the block's top instead.

0x405aa0.name: CreateFixedSpace
0x405aa0.evidence: (medium) Allocates count*aligned element size + 0x30 from the heap (FUN_004058d0, top) and builds a FixedSpace at the end of it. Its fields are set @7=tag, @8=this and @10=index.

0x405b40.name: UIAllocator
0x405b40.evidence: (high) The constructor: the RegularAllocator constructor, then UIAllocator's vftable.

0x405b80.name: FileAllocator
0x405b80.evidence: (high) The constructor: the RegularAllocator constructor, then FileAllocator's vftable.

0x405bc0.name: CreateMemorySpace
0x405bc0.evidence: (high) Switches on type 0..3 to build a System, Regular, UI or File allocator (0xdc bytes, or a static at 0x1370bc4 when no default space exists). It wraps it in a 0x14-byte MemorySpace (or the static 0x1370bb0).

0x405e30.name: Allocate
0x405e30.evidence: (medium) Slot 5, under the lock: for sizes that map to a fixed class (FUN_00404cd0) it allocates from the FixedSpace lists @0x1c[i], making one with CreateFixedSpace. Otherwise it uses AllocateFromHeap and stores the tag @-4.

0x405f60.name: InitializeMemorySystem
0x405f60.evidence: (medium) Builds the default MemorySpace DAT_01370bd4 over a SystemAllocator and SystemManagedAllocator ManagedSpaces (DAT_01370bf8, DAT_01370bf4). It also builds the MemorySpaces DAT_01370bd8..be4 and the object DAT_01370bc8 (FUN_00429680).

0x406500.name: GetDefaultMemorySpace
0x406500.evidence: (high) Returns DAT_01370bd4, calling InitializeMemorySystem first if it is null.

0x406550.name: Initialize
0x406550.evidence: (high) Slot 1: stores the space @0x20 and the range start/size @0x24/@0x28. It allocates the first 0x28-byte ManagedBlock covering the whole range into @4.

0x406620.name: Initialize
0x406620.evidence: (high) Slot 1: stores the given space, or the default space, @4.

0x406650.name: Allocate
0x406650.evidence: (medium) Slot 3: gets the allocator through slot 9 and calls its slot 4 (+0x10) with (this, size, max(align @8, align)). If that fails it initialises the memory system when there is no default space.

0x4066a0.name: AllocateTagged
0x4066a0.evidence: (medium) Slot 5: like slot 3 but calls the allocator's slot 5 (+0x14) with an extra argument (tag/flags).

0x406710.name: MemoryAllocate
0x406710.evidence: (medium) Takes the allocator from TLS +8, or the global DAT_01370bd4 (made by FUN_00405f60 if missing), and calls its slot 0xc with (size, align).

0x406750.name: MemoryAllocateAlignRef
0x406750.evidence: (medium) Same as MemoryAllocate, but the second argument is dereferenced (*param_2) before being passed as the alignment to allocator slot 0xc.

0x4067a0.name: MemoryAllocateSafe
0x4067a0.evidence: (medium) If DAT_01370bcc is set, calls the thread/global allocator slot 0xc(size, align). Otherwise it calls __aligned_malloc(size, align), with the alignment defaulting to 0x10.

0x4068c0.name: AllocateManagedBlock
0x4068c0.evidence: (medium) Allocates a 0x28-byte ManagedBlock from the allocator @this+4 and sets its vftables, then allocates (param_2, param_3) for the data. Stores the data pointer @8, the size @0x14 and param_1 @0x18; frees the block with FUN_00406810 if the data allocation fails.

0x406940.name: FreeManagedBlock
0x406940.evidence: (medium) Gets the data pointer from the block's slot 1 and frees it, then frees the block itself. Each free goes through allocator slot 0x1c, or __aligned_free when DAT_01370bcc is 0.

0x4069f0.name: AllocateMemory
0x4069f0.evidence: (high) Takes the allocator from the TLS block (+8) or the global @0x1370bd4 (created by 0x405f60). When @0x1370bcc is set it calls the allocator's slot 3 as (size, 0), otherwise __aligned_malloc(size, 0x10). Called by std::locale, std::_Mutex and about 400 other sites as operator new.

0x406c70.name: ShutdownMemorySystem

0x4d7550.evidence: (high) Builds {x, y, right-x, bottom-y, minZ, maxZ} from a rect and two floats and calls the device @0x1c slot 0xbc (SetViewport).

0x4d75c0.name: ApplyBlendState
0x4d75c0.evidence: (high) Unpacks a bitfield into SetRenderState calls: 0x1b ALPHABLENDENABLE, 0xab/0x13/0x14 blend op/src/dest, 0xd1/0xcf/0xd0 alpha blend, 0xce SEPARATEALPHABLENDENABLE, and 0xa8/0xbe-0xc0 COLORWRITEENABLE0-3. Caches the value @0x40.

0x4d7720.name: ApplyDepthState
0x4d7720.evidence: (high) SetRenderState 7 ZENABLE (forced off when @0x34 is 0), 0xe ZWRITEENABLE and 0x17 ZFUNC from bitfields. Caches the value @0x44.

0x4d7790.name: ApplyStencilState
0x4d7790.evidence: (high) SetRenderState 0x34 STENCILENABLE. When enabled, also sets 0x38 func, 0x39 ref, 0x3a mask, 0x3b writemask, and 0x35/0x36/0x37 fail/zfail/pass. Caches the values @0x48/@0x4c.

0x4d7890.name: ApplyRasterizerState
0x4d7890.evidence: (high) SetRenderState 8 FILLMODE, 0x16 CULLMODE, 0xae SCISSORTESTENABLE, 0xc3 DEPTHBIAS (converted from half float) and 0xaf SLOPESCALEDEPTHBIAS. Caches the value @0x50.

0x4d79a0.name: ApplyVertexStreams
0x4d79a0.evidence: (high) Calls SetVertexDeclaration (slot 0x15c) when the declaration differs from @0x58. For each stream differing from the cache @0x130, calls SetStreamSource (slot 400). Calls SetStreamSourceFreq (slot 0x198) for instancing changes against the mask @0x128.

0x4d7b30.name: ForceApplyVertexStreams
0x4d7b30.evidence: (high) Uncached version of ApplyVertexStreams: always sets the declaration, the streams and all 8 frequencies, then memcpys the streams into @0x130.

0x4d7c80.name: ApplyVertexShaderConstants
0x4d7c80.evidence: (high) For each constant entry differing from the cache @0x60, calls SetVertexShaderConstantF (slot 0x178) with the register from the shader's table.

0x4d7d30.name: ForceApplyVertexShaderConstants
0x4d7d30.evidence: (high) Calls SetVertexShaderConstantF for every entry and memcpys them into the cache @0x60.

0x4d7da0.name: BindVertexShader
0x4d7da0.evidence: (high) Remaps the constant cache @0x60 from the previous shader @0x5c to the new shader's register list. Calls SetVertexShader (slot 0x170) with @0x2c of the shader and stores the shader @0x5c.

0x4d7ee0.name: ApplyVertexTextures
0x4d7ee0.evidence: (high) For vertex texture samplers (stage+0x101 = D3DVERTEXTEXTURESAMPLER0), calls SetTexture (slot 0x104) and SetSamplerState (slot 0x114: address U/V/W, LOD bias, max aniso) only when they differ from the cache.

0x4d8030.name: ForceApplyVertexTextures
0x4d8030.evidence: (high) Uncached version of ApplyVertexTextures: always calls SetTexture and SetSamplerState for each vertex sampler and updates the cache.

0x4d8210.name: ForceApplyPixelShaderConstants
0x4d8210.evidence: (high) Calls SetPixelShaderConstantF for every entry and memcpys them into the cache @0xc8.

0x4d8280.name: BindPixelShader
0x4d8280.evidence: (high) Remaps the constant cache @0xc8 from the previous shader @0xc0. Calls SetPixelShader (slot 0x1ac) with @0x28 of the shader and stores the shader @0xc0.

0x4d83c0.name: ApplyPixelTextures
0x4d83c0.evidence: (high) Cached SetTexture/SetSamplerState per pixel sampler (address, filters 5/6/7, mip LOD bias, aniso, SRGBTEXTURE 0xb) against the cache @0x194/@0x198. Unbinds samplers dropped from the mask @0x214.

0x4d8690.name: ForceApplyPixelTextures
0x4d8690.evidence: (high) Uncached version of ApplyPixelTextures: always sets texture and sampler states for each sampler, clears unused ones, and stores the mask @0x214.

0x4d8900.name: ExecuteClear
0x4d8900.evidence: (medium) If the flag @0x20 is set, calls device slot 0xa8 (EndScene) and clears the flag. It then calls device slot 0xac (Clear) with a rect count/pointer from @0x14, flags from bits 1/2/4 of @4, a color from bytes @8..@0xb, z @0xc and stencil @0x10.

0x4d89a0.name: ExecutePresent
0x4d89a0.evidence: (medium) Ends a pending scene (device slot 0xa8), then calls slot 3 (Present) of the swap chain at (cmd@4)+0x3c with all-zero arguments.

0x4d89e0.name: ExecuteCopySurfaceRect
0x4d89e0.evidence: (medium) Gets the source and destination surfaces (texture slot 0x48 GetSurfaceLevel, or the surface @0x34). It builds a dest rect at offset @0xc/@0x10 sized from the source rect or the mip size, then calls device slot 0x88 (StretchRect) with filter 1 and releases the surfaces.

0x4d8b40.name: CopyTextureByLock
0x4d8b40.evidence: (medium) Switches on the texture type (@0x2c & 0x3c00000). For each type it locks source and destination (slot 0x4c), memcpys pitch*rows, and unlocks (slot 0x50); the cube case loops over 6 faces.

0x4d8da0.name: ExecuteCopyTexture
0x4d8da0.evidence: (medium) Calls CopyTextureByLock unless the destination has flag 0x200000 or the source has flags 0x300000 in @0x2c.

0x4d8dd0.name: ExecuteStretchRect
0x4d8dd0.evidence: (medium) Ends a pending scene, gets the two surfaces (slot 0x48 or @0x34), then calls device slot 0x88 (StretchRect) with the rects @0x18/@0xc. The filter is 2 if bit 31 of @0x14 is set, else 1.

0x4d8ef0.name: ExecuteGetRenderTargetData
0x4d8ef0.evidence: (medium) Gets level 0 of the texture at +0x38+idx*4 and calls device slot 0x80 (GetRenderTargetData) from the surface @0x34 into it.

0x4d8f50.name: ExecuteSaveTexture
0x4d8f50.evidence: (high) Calls D3DXSaveTextureToFileA, or D3DXSaveSurfaceToFileA for a bare surface, with the path/format from the command. It then calls the command's completion callback @0x14 with the texture's width and height.

0x4d9000.name: LoadCopyrightResources
0x4d9000.evidence: (high) Loads shader/shcd/SaveTextureRightsVS.shcd, SaveTextureRightsPS.shcd and common/graphics/texture/screenShotCopyRights.tex. It keeps their resources (with refcounts) @0x10/@0x14/@0x18.

0x4d9170.name: SaveThread
0x4d9170.evidence: (high) Constructor: calls the base thread constructor, sets SaveThread's vftable, creates two events (@0x18, @0x1c) and zeroes @0x38.

0x4d91b0.name: RequestSave
0x4d91b0.evidence: (medium) Copies six dwords of parameters to @0x20..@0x34, AddRefs the surface and stores it @0x38, then signals the event @0x18.

0x4d9240.name: Run
0x4d9240.evidence: (high) Loops until the quit byte @0x14 is set: waits on @0x18, calls D3DXSaveSurfaceToFileW(@0x24, @0x28, the surface @0x38) and stores the result @0x3c. It then releases the surface and signals @0x1c.

0x4d92b0.name: RenderThread
0x4d92b0.evidence: (high) Constructor: calls the base thread constructor, sets RenderThread's vftable and creates two events @0x18/@0x1c.

0x4d92f0.name: CallbackManager
0x4d92f0.evidence: (high) Constructor: sets CallbackManager's vftable, initializes the critical section @4 and zeroes @0x1c/@0x20/@0x24.

0x4d9320.name: Register
0x4d9320.evidence: (high) Under the lock, finds the first 8-byte slot in the array @0x1c (capacity @0x20) whose first word is zero. It stores the (func, arg) pair there, increments @0x24 and returns the index, or -1 when there is no free slot.

0x4d93c0.name: InvokeCallbacks
0x4d93c0.evidence: (high) Under the CS @4, calls each non-null function of the (fn, arg) pairs in the array @0x1c (count @0x20).

0x4d9410.name: SetTrackedSize
0x4d9410.evidence: (medium) Rounds the size up to 16 and adds the difference from the old size atomically to the global memory counter @0xd8 + (category in @8 & 0xf)*4. Stores the new size in the high bits of @8.

0x4d9460.name: ReleaseResource
0x4d9460.evidence: (medium) Atomically decrements the use count @0x2c and releases the D3D buffer(s) @0x20 (three if bit 0 of @0x1c is set). It subtracts the size kept in @8 from the manager's memory counter at 0xd8.

0x4d9500.name: CreateResource
0x4d9500.evidence: (medium) Calls device slot 0x68 (CreateVertexBuffer) with length @0x18, usage from the flags @0x1c and pool 0/1/2. When bit 0 is set it creates two more, then adds the size to the manager's memory counter @0xd8.

0x4d9650.name: OnDeviceLost
0x4d9650.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: calls VertexBuffer ReleaseResource (0x4d9460) unless the flags have 0x4c set.

0x4d9660.name: OnDeviceReset
0x4d9660.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: unless flags 0x4c are set, recreates the buffer with 0x4d9500 and releases it (0x4d9460) on failure.

0x4d9690.name: ReleaseResource
0x4d9690.evidence: (medium) The same release as 0x4d9460 with the fields shifted by 4 (buffers @0x24, use count @0x30), and the same memory counter update.

0x4d9730.name: CreateResource
0x4d9730.evidence: (high) Calls device slot 0x6c (CreateIndexBuffer) with format 0x65 (INDEX16) or 0x66 (INDEX32) chosen by @0x1c being 1 or 2. It creates three buffers when bit 0 of the flags is set and updates the memory counter.

0x4d9870.name: OnDeviceLost
0x4d9870.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: calls IndexBuffer ReleaseResource (0x4d9690) unless flags 0x4c are set.

0x4d9880.name: OnDeviceReset
0x4d9880.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: recreates the buffer with 0x4d9730 and releases it (0x4d9690) on failure.

0x4d99c0.name: Create
0x4d99c0.evidence: (high) Copies the 4-byte element descriptors to @0xc and builds D3DVERTEXELEMENT9s with ToD3DDeclType/ToD3DDeclUsage, ending with the 0xff/0x11 end marker. It calls device slot 0x158 (CreateVertexDeclaration) into @0x20 and records stream and usage masks @0x14/@0x18/@0x1c.

0x4d9b40.name: Release
0x4d9b40.evidence: (medium) Releases the D3D declaration @0x20 and frees the element copy @0xc, zeroing @0x10.

0x4d9c00.name: FreeParameterTables
0x4d9c00.evidence: (medium) Frees the tables allocated by 0x4d9b80 and zeroes their counts @0xc/@0x14. Called by VertexShader::vf1 and PixelShader::vf1.

0x4d9cc0.name: ReleaseResources
0x4d9cc0.evidence: (medium) Frees the per-entry array @0x44 (count byte @0x24, 0xc-byte entries) through the allocator @0x1371270 and Releases the COM objects @0x34..@0x40, and @0x30 for some format bits of @0x2c. It then subtracts its tracked size from the global memory counters.

0x4d9de0.name: LockBox
0x4d9de0.evidence: (medium) Only for type 0x1000000 (volume): calls slot 0x4c (LockBox) on @0x30 into a 12-byte locked box. When the shadow table @0x44 exists, it frees that level's saved copy and records the bits pointer and slice size there. Called by ProjectTextureToSH.

0x4d9ed0.name: UnlockBox
0x4d9ed0.evidence: (medium) For a volume texture, copies the locked level into a new allocation kept in the shadow table @0x44, then calls slot 0x50 (UnlockBox).

0x4d9f60.name: ToD3DFormat
0x4d9f60.evidence: (high) Maps engine texture format codes to D3DFORMAT: 0x3420/0x3430/0x3431 to DXT1/DXT3/DXT5, 0x1450 to A8R8G8B8 (0x15), 0x2460 to A16B16G16R16F. 0x4250 maps to INTZ/RAWZ/D24S8 depending on the device caps @0x34.

0x4da150.name: CreateResource
0x4da150.evidence: (high) Calls device slot 0x5c/0x60/0x64 (CreateTexture/CreateVolumeTexture/CreateCubeTexture) chosen by the type @0x2c, with size, mip count and ToD3DFormat. It sums the mip-chain memory into the manager counter @0xd8 and gets surface level 0 for render targets.

0x4da3e0.name: OnDeviceLost
0x4da3e0.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: calls the release function 0x4d9cc0 unless flags 0x4c are set.

0x4da3f0.name: OnDeviceReset
0x4da3f0.evidence: (medium) Thunk at this-0xc: recreates through CreateResource. For a managed volume texture with a shadow table, it recreates the volume (slot 0x60) and copies each level back with LockBox/UnlockBox.

0x4da550.name: Create
0x4da550.evidence: (medium) Stores width/height @0x18/@0x1c, mip count @0x24 and the format @0x28 if non-zero, then calls CreateResource and releases (0x4d9cc0) on failure.

0x4da5a0.name: Release
0x4da5a0.evidence: (medium) Releases the kernel textures @0x38 and @0x34 (slot 3) and the COM object @0x3c (slot 2), then atomically subtracts the memory size in @8 (above the low nibble) from the device's per-type counter @0xd8+type*4.

0x4da610.name: OnDeviceLost
0x4da610.evidence: (medium) Notifier thunk (this-0xc): calls Release (0x4da5a0) only when the flags byte tested with 0x4c is clear, i.e. for default-pool resources.

0x4da620.name: ReleaseD3DResources
0x4da620.evidence: (medium) Runs FUN_004d9cc0 on the textures @0x38 and @0x34 and COM-Releases @0x3c; the failure path of InitFromD3DSwapChain calls it.

0x4da660.name: InitFromD3DSwapChain
0x4da660.evidence: (medium) Stores and AddRefs the COM object @0x3c and calls its slot 5 GetBackBuffer(0,0,&surf). Texture::InitFromSurface on @0x34 then sets width/height/format @0x18/@0x1c/@0x20, and the depth texture @0x38 is sized to match and created with FUN_004da150.

0x4da760.name: CreateD3DQuery
0x4da760.evidence: (high) Maps the type @0x18 (1,2,3) to D3DQUERYTYPE 8/9/10 (event, occlusion, timestamp; timestamp only when the frequency global is set) and calls device CreateQuery (slot 0x1d8) into @0x1c.

0x4da7c0.name: InitTimestampFrequency
0x4da7c0.evidence: (high) Creates a D3DQUERYTYPE_TIMESTAMPFREQ (0xc) query, Issues END and spins on GetData into the 64-bit global DAT_01375a30, divides it by 1000000 and releases the query. When the query cannot be created the frequency stays 0.

0x4da890.name: CreateD3DQuery
0x4da890.evidence: (medium) Same type mapping as Query::CreateD3DQuery (1/2/3 to 8/9/10) but with the type @0xc and the result @0x10, which it releases on failure.

0x4dac40.name: CreateTextureFromD3DTexture
0x4dac40.evidence: (high) Allocates 0x48 bytes and runs Texture::Texture on them, puts the low nibble of param_4 into @8, then calls Texture::InitFromD3DTexture; on failure releases it through slot 3. Called by TextureRenderer.

0x4dad50.name: AddCallback
0x4dad50.evidence: (medium) Forwards both arguments to FUN_004d9320 on the callback list @0x18, the list from which RemoveCallback clears entries.

0x4dad60.name: RemoveCallback
0x4dad60.evidence: (medium) Under the list's CS @4, zeroes the (fn, arg) pair at the index in the array @0x1c of the list @0x18 and decrements @0x24.

0x4daee0.name: ApplyDisplaySettings
0x4daee0.evidence: (high) Applies a pending window resize (@0x68/@0x6c to @0x90/@0x94) and a windowed/fullscreen switch (@0x4d to @0x4c, mode index @0x60). The switch changes the style with SetWindowLongA (0xcf0000 or WS_POPUP|WS_VISIBLE) and calls SetWindowPos. Changing the frame-limit mode (@0xa4 to @0xa0) restarts the timer; it sets the state @0x38 = 2 to request a reset.

0x4db060.name: BuildPresentParameters
0x4db060.evidence: (high) Fills the 0x38-byte D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS: back buffer size, format 0x16, Windowed and the refresh rate from the mode list @0x70. The presentation interval is 1/2/4 or IMMEDIATE (0x80000000) by the mode @0xa0, which also sets the limiter flag @0xa8.

0x4db190.name: ReleaseDeviceResources
0x4db190.evidence: (medium) Calls the device's slot 0x14 (EvictManagedResources), then slot 1 of the listeners at the head @0x1375a40 under the CS @0x1375a44. It releases the sub-objects @0x34/@0x38 and the swap chain @0x3c, then sets @0x38 = 3 and @0x54 = 6.

0x4db340.name: LoadDepthCopyShaders
0x4db340.evidence: (high) Loads "shader/shcd/DepthCopyVS.shcd" and "DepthCopyPS.shcd" (tag 'shcd') into @0x218/@0x21c and takes their shaders from +0x98/+0x9c into @0x220/@0x224 with AddRef/Release. Then initialises the object @0x230 with FUN_004d9000.

0x4db440.name: SetScissorRect
0x4db440.evidence: (medium) Takes the target size @0x24+0x18/0x1c shifted right by the mip level @0x38, clamps the rect argument against it with FUN_004e28b0 into this+8, then calls device slot 300 (SetScissorRect).

0x4db4a0.name: ExecuteCallbackCommand
0x4db4a0.evidence: (medium) When bit 1 of the command's @0xc is set, calls the function @4 with the argument @8.

0x4db500.name: ResetDeviceState
0x4db500.evidence: (medium) Resyncs the cached states @0x40..@0x50 with the globals. Clears all 16 textures (SetTexture), ends a pending scene (EndScene, flag @0x20), binds the device's back buffer as RT0 and clears RT1-3, sets the depth surface and a full-size viewport, then SetRenderState(0x9c,1).

0x4db6f0.name: Initialize
0x4db6f0.evidence: (medium) Calls the device's CreateVertexDeclaration (slot 0x158) with an element array, result kept @0x28. Allocates a 0x40-byte SaveThread (vftable, two CreateEventA handles at [6]/[7]), stores it @0x2c, starts it as "SaveTextureThread" and zeroes 0x34..0x44.

0x4db7e0.name: Finalize
0x4db7e0.evidence: (medium) Stops the thread @0x2c: calls its slot 1, SetEvent on handle [6], FUN_004cf020, then deletes it. Releases the COM objects @0x28/@0x24 (slot 2) and the objects @0x18/@0x14/@0x10 (slot 3), zeroing each pointer.

0x4db880.name: BeginCapture
0x4db880.evidence: (medium) Creates a lockable render target (CreateRenderTarget, slot 0x70) of the source's size, format 0x15 turned into 0x16, and StretchRects (slot 0x88) the source surface into it, keeping it @0x24. On either failure it calls the callback @0x250 with status 1 or 2.

0x4db9a0.name: RenderCapture
0x4db9a0.evidence: (medium) Binds the capture surface @0x24 as the render target, sets a viewport and a long list of render and sampler states, binds its texture, shader and declaration, and draws a 2-triangle strip with DrawPrimitiveUP inside BeginScene/EndScene. Sets the state to 3.

0x4dbf10.name: UpdateCapture
0x4dbf10.evidence: (medium) State machine on *@0x1c: in state 3 waits for @0x34; in state 4 hands the surface to the writer FUN_004d91b0, goes to 5 and releases the surface. Otherwise polls the writer's event (WaitForSingleObject 0), calls the callback @0x250 with 0 or 2 and resets to state 0.

0x4dbff0.name: Initialize
0x4dbff0.evidence: (medium) Rejects more than one usage bit, stores the size @0x18 and the flags @0x1c and clears @0x20..0x28. Creates through FUN_004d9500 when eager (flags & 0x4c or device mode 0/1/4). CreateKernelVertexBuffer calls it.

0x4dc210.name: Release
0x4dc210.evidence: (medium) Vtable slot 1: COM-Releases the declaration @0x20, frees @0xc through the allocator's slot 4 and zeroes @0x10.

0x4dc250.name: Release
0x4dc250.evidence: (medium) Vtable slot 1: COM-Releases the D3D vertex shader @0x2c, then calls the base cleanup FUN_004d9c00.

0x4dc280.name: Initialize
0x4dc280.evidence: (high) Runs the base init FUN_004d9b80, stores @0x24/@0x28 from the bytecode header and calls device CreateVertexShader (slot 0x16c) on the bytecode at param_1+4, storing the result @0x2c.

0x4dc300.name: Release
0x4dc300.evidence: (medium) Vtable slot 1: COM-Releases the D3D pixel shader @0x28, then calls FUN_004d9c00.

0x4dc330.name: Initialize
0x4dc330.evidence: (high) Runs the base init FUN_004d9b80, stores @0x24 and calls device CreatePixelShader (slot 0x1a8), storing the result @0x28.

0x4dc3d0.name: Initialize2D
0x4dc3d0.evidence: (medium) Sets width/height @0x18/@0x1c from the size pair, depth 1 @0x20, levels @0x24, format @0x28 and flags (f & 0xfcbfffff)|0x800000 @0x2c. Creates through FUN_004da150 when eager.

0x4dc560.name: InitializeCube
0x4dc560.evidence: (medium) A single edge size sets both @0x18 and @0x1c; depth 1, and flags (f & 0xfe3fffff)|0x2000000 @0x2c.

0x4dc6d0.name: Initialize
0x4dc6d0.evidence: (medium) Stores the non-zero type @0x18 and creates the query through CreateD3DQuery (0x4da760) when the device mode is 0/1/4, releasing @0x1c on failure.

0x4dc980.name: InitializeDummyTexture
0x4dc980.evidence: (high) Initializes the subobject @8 via FUN_004db340. Loads "common/graphics/texture/dummy.tex" through the resource manager into @0xd0 and keeps its +0xfc object @0xd4 with refcounting.

0x4dca20.name: CreateKernelTexture2D
0x4dca20.evidence: (high) Allocates a 0x48-byte Texture (Texture::Texture), sets the low nibble of @8 and calls Initialize2D (0x4dc3d0); on failure releases it through slot 3.

0x4dca90.name: CreateKernelTexture3D
0x4dca90.evidence: (medium) Allocates a 0x48-byte Texture and calls Initialize3D (0x4dc480); on failure releases it.

0x4dcb00.name: CreateKernelTextureCube
0x4dcb00.evidence: (medium) Allocates a 0x48-byte Texture and calls InitializeCube (0x4dc560); on failure releases it.

0x4dcb70.name: CreateKernelVertexShader
0x4dcb70.evidence: (high) Allocates 0x30 bytes, sets VertexShader's vftable inline and calls VertexShader::Initialize (0x4dc280).

0x4dcc00.name: CreateKernelPixelShader
0x4dcc00.evidence: (high) Allocates 0x2c bytes, sets PixelShader's vftable inline and calls PixelShader::Initialize (0x4dc330).

0x4dcc90.name: CreateKernelVertexBuffer
0x4dcc90.evidence: (high) Allocates 0x34 bytes, runs VertexBuffer::VertexBuffer and calls VertexBuffer::Initialize (0x4dbff0) with size and flags; called by Primitive::Server::Initialize.

0x4dccf0.name: CreateIndexBuffer
0x4dccf0.evidence: (medium) Allocates 0x38 bytes from the allocator @DAT_01371270+8 and runs the IndexBuffer constructor on it. Puts param_4's low 4 bits into @8, then initializes through FUN_004dc090 and destroys the object through vtable slot 3 on failure.

0x4dcd60.name: CreateConstantBuffer
0x4dcd60.evidence: (high) Allocates 0x2c bytes and sets ConstantBuffer's vftable, zeroing @8..@0x28. Merges param_3 & 0xf into @8 and initializes through FUN_004dc130; on failure it destroys the object through slot 3.

0x4dd100.name: ExecuteSetRenderTargets
0x4dd100.evidence: (medium) Command type 0 of ExecuteCommands. Ends the scene if open, then sets 4 render targets with SetRenderTarget (0x94), taking a surface level through the texture's vf 0x48 for cube targets. Sets the depth stencil (0x9c), caches the targets @0x24..@0x3c, then sets the scissor rect (0x12c) and the viewport (0xbc) from the mip-shifted size.

0x4dd310.name: ExecuteCallback
0x4dd310.evidence: (medium) Command type 0xb. With flag bit 0 @0xc it begins the scene and resets the stencil, fill, cull, scissor and depth-bias render states (SetRenderState 0xe4 with 0x34..0x3b, 8, 0x16, 0xae, 0xc3, 0xaf). It then calls the function pointer @4 with @8.

0x4dd470.name: FlushSaveTextureWork
0x4dd470.evidence: (medium) Ends the scene (EndScene 0xa8) if one is open and runs FUN_004db9a0 on the SaveTextureWork @0x230. It then begins the scene again (BeginScene 0xa4) and sets the flag @0x20.

0x4dd4b0.name: QueueSaveTexture
0x4dd4b0.evidence: (medium) Forwards the command's @8, @4 and @0x10 to FUN_004db880 on the SaveTextureWork @0x230. ExecuteCommands' case 0xe makes the same call.

0x4dd4e0.name: ApplyDrawState
0x4dd4e0.evidence: (medium) Begins the scene if needed and compares the packed state words against the cache @0x40..@0x5c, calling the setters 0x4d75c0..0x4d83c0 for those that differ. 0x978640.name: MakeSortKey
0x978640.evidence: (medium) Builds a 64-bit key: a global counter (DAT_014a0a10, incremented) in the low 16 bits, above it the float times a double constant plus 0x7fffffffffff; arg 2 is stored @8.

0x978690.name: SortKeyLess
0x978690.evidence: (medium) Compares two 64-bit values by the high dword @4, then the low dword @0; returns 1 when the first is smaller.

0x9786c0.name: FloatLess
0x9786c0.evidence: (medium) Returns 1 when *a < *b for two float pointers, else 0; a comparison predicate.

0x978780.name: SetFlagBit10
0x978780.evidence: (medium) Sets bit 10 (0x400) of the u16 flags @0x3ac from bit 0 of the argument.

0x9787c0.name: SetFlagBit12
0x9787c0.evidence: (medium) Sets bit 12 (0x1000) of the u16 flags @0x3ac from bit 0 of the argument.

0x9787f0.name: SetFlagBit13
0x9787f0.evidence: (medium) Sets bit 13 (0x2000) of the u16 flags @0x3ac from bit 0 of the argument; FUN_00978ae0 does the same inline before calling the object's slot 11.

0x978830.name: SetFlagBit14
0x978830.evidence: (medium) Sets bit 14 (0x4000) of the u16 flags @0x3ac from bit 0 of the argument.

0x978870.name: FloatLess2
0x978870.evidence: (medium) Identical to 0x9786c0: returns 1 when *a < *b for two float pointers.

0x9788a0.name: SinF
0x9788a0.evidence: (high) Returns fsin of the float argument, rounded to float.

0x9788c0.name: CosF
0x9788c0.evidence: (high) Returns fcos of the float argument, rounded to float.

0x978910.name: HermiteBasis
0x978910.evidence: (medium) Computes t^2 and t^3 and writes c1*t^3 - c2*t^2 + c3, c2*t^2 - c1*t^3, t^3 - c1*t^2 + t and t^3 - t^2 to four outputs (c1 @0x1092098, c2 @0x10944e0, c3 @0x1088130). With c1=2, c2=3, c3=1 these are the cubic Hermite basis functions.

0x978970.name: RefPtr
0x978970.evidence: (medium) Stores the object pointer @0 of this, calls the object's vtable slot 3 (+0xc, apparently AddRef) and returns this.

0x978c20.name: RandomRange
0x978c20.evidence: (high) Steps the xorshift128 state at DAT_013301dc..e8 (shifts 11, 8, 19). Returns min + (max-min)*(r & 0xffff)/DAT_0109cab0; called by the FunctionCurve and Value communicator/runtime vfuncs.

0x978d10.name: AddEntry
0x978d10.evidence: (medium) If the count @0x1568 is below 0x80, stores arg1 @0x116c+count*8 and increments the count; returns the old count.

0x9790e0.name: AllocAligned
0x9790e0.evidence: (medium) If the allocator hook @0x14a0a14 is set and size != 0, calls it with (size, alignment arg, file/line globals 0x10daa3c/0x10daa38, 0); otherwise returns 0.

0x979110.name: FreeAligned
0x979110.evidence: (medium) Calls the free hook @0x14a0a18 on a non-null pointer.

0x979150.name: ComputeRotatedQuadCorners
0x979150.evidence: (medium) If @0 is non-zero: sin/cos of the angle @0x14 times the constant @0x1088108 make four rotated corner offsets, scaled by @4 (x) and @8 (y) and offset by @0xc/@0x10 plus the constant, written to 8 float outputs.

0x979350.name: InitBlockPool
0x979350.evidence: (medium) Allocates the given size aligned to 0x80 into @0x14a09f4, sets the block count (size>>10) and the free count, and links every 0x400-byte block to the next one, the last to 0xffffffff.

0x979430.name: FreePoolBlock
0x979430.evidence: (medium) Computes the block index (ptr - base) >> 10, writes the free-list head @0x14a09e8 into the block, makes it the head and increments the free count @0x14a09f0.

0x9794d0.name: ReleaseDeviceObjects
0x9794d0.evidence: (medium) Calls virtual slot 1 on the objects @4, @8, @0x68, @0x6c, @0xc and @0x10, and finally @0 (the device), clearing each pointer.

0x979560.name: CreateMeshBuffers
0x979560.evidence: (medium) Allocates a 0x18-byte record holding the counts read @4/@8/@0xc. Copies the u16 array and the 0x1c-byte entries into aligned allocations, then creates a count*0x24-byte vertex buffer (device slot 0x10, locked by 0x70, unlocked by 0x78) and a u16 index buffer (slots 0x14, 0x6c, 0x74), filling both with memcpy; on failure it cleans up.

0x979800.name: ApplyRenderFlags
0x979800.evidence: (medium) Decodes the flags word @0x30: bits 8 and 9 go to device slot 0x20, bit 10 to slot 0x24, and the low 4 bits to slot 0x2c.

0x979860.name: ApplySamplerStates
0x979860.evidence: (medium) For each of 6 stages whose bit is set in the mask @0x64, calls device slots 0x40, 0x44 and 0x34 with the 8-byte per-stage records starting near @0x34.

0x9798d0.name: UnlockBuffers
0x9798d0.evidence: (medium) If the lock flag @0x74 is set, clears it and calls device slot 0x78 on @0x68; if the flag @0x84 is set, clears it and calls slot 0x74 on @0x6c.

0x979940.name: AllocAligned16
0x979940.evidence: (medium) Calls the allocator hook @0x14a0a14 with (size, 0x10, file/line globals, 0) for a non-zero size.

0x979970.name: AllocAligned16Alt
0x979970.evidence: (medium) Identical copy of AllocAligned16: the allocator hook @0x14a0a14 with alignment 0x10.

0x9799a0.name: FreeAligned16
0x9799a0.evidence: (medium) Calls the free hook @0x14a0a18 on a non-null pointer.

0x9799c0.name: FreeAligned16Alt
0x9799c0.evidence: (medium) Identical copy: calls the free hook @0x14a0a18 on a non-null pointer.

0x9799e0.name: ~Model
0x9799e0.evidence: (high) Sets the Model vftable, releases the buffers @8/@0xc of its data @4, frees the data's arrays @0 and @4, deletes the data, then sets the IModel vftable. Called by Model::vf0.

0x979ad0.name: ~Texture
0x979ad0.evidence: (high) Sets the Texture vftable, calls slot 1 of the object @4 and clears it, then sets the ITexture vftable.

0x979cd0.name: ~FunctionCurve
0x979cd0.evidence: (high) Sets the FunctionCurve vftable, frees the key data @4 through the hook @0x14a0a18, then sets the IFunctionCurve vftable.

0x979d00.name: HermiteBasis
0x979d00.evidence: (high) From t writes 2t^3-3t^2+1, 3t^2-2t^3, t^3-2t^2+t and t^3-t^2 into four outputs.

0x979d60.name: ComputeStartTangent
0x979d60.evidence: (medium) Uses the signed tangent bytes @+10/@+11 of key i over a constant and the value deltas to keys i+1 and i-1, scaled by the key-time spans (u16 & 0x3fff).

0x979e30.name: ComputeEndTangent
0x979e30.evidence: (medium) Uses the tangent bytes @+0x12/@+0x13 of key i, the value delta to key i+1 and, when there are enough keys (count bits 9..24 of the header), to key i+2, scaled by the time ratio.

0x979f10.name: EvaluateHermite
0x979f10.evidence: (high) Normalises the time between key i and key i+1, then combines the two values and the tangents from ComputeStartTangent/ComputeEndTangent with Hermite basis weights.

0x979ff0.name: EvaluateLinear
0x979ff0.evidence: (high) v0 + (v1 - v0) * (t - t0) / (t1 - t0) between key i and key i+1.

0x97a060.name: EvaluateStep
0x97a060.evidence: (high) Returns the value of key i+1 when t >= its time, otherwise the value of key i.

0x97a0b0.name: FindKeyIndex
0x97a0b0.evidence: (high) Binary search over the key times (u16 & 0x3fff) for the segment containing t; the key count comes from header bits 9..24.

0x97a150.name: GetFirstValue
0x97a150.evidence: (medium) Returns the float at keys+4, the first key's value, ignoring its 3 arguments.

0x97a160.name: GetFirstValueAt
0x97a160.evidence: (medium) Returns the float at keys+4, the first key's value, ignoring its argument.

0x97a170.name: EvaluateLoop
0x97a170.evidence: (medium) Wraps t into the range [first key time, last key time] and finds the segment with FindKeyIndex. Then calls the interpolator picked by the next key's top 2 time bits from the method table @0x10 (8 bytes per entry).

0x97a220.name: EvaluateLoopOffset
0x97a220.evidence: (medium) Same wrapping and dispatch as EvaluateLoop, but subtracts (last value - first value) * the number of cycles wrapped from the result.

0x97a2f0.name: GetLastValue
0x97a2f0.evidence: (medium) Returns the value of the last key, keys[count*2-1] with the count from header bits 9..24.

0x97a310.name: EvaluateRepeat
0x97a310.evidence: (medium) Wraps the time into the span from the first key time (u16 & 0x3fff @data+8) to the last key time. It then finds the key with FUN_0097a0b0 and calls the interpolator chosen by the key's top two bits from the member-pointer table @0x10.

0x97a3c0.name: EvaluateOffsetRepeat
0x97a3c0.evidence: (medium) Does the same wrap as EvaluateRepeat. It then adds (last key value - first key value) times the number of cycles to the interpolated result.

0x97a490.name: EvaluateOnce
0x97a490.evidence: (medium) With no time wrap, it finds the key with FUN_0097a0b0 and calls the interpolator selected by the key's flags >>14 from the table @0x10.

0x97a4d0.name: Evaluate
0x97a4d0.evidence: (medium) Slot 4: calls the member function pointer @0x8 (this adjusted by @0xc) with its three float arguments.

0x97a5e0.name: Evaluate
0x97a5e0.evidence: (medium) Slot 4: calls the member function pointer @0x78 (this adjusted by @0x7c) with (float, float, arg).

0x97a7c0.name: Evaluate
0x97a7c0.evidence: (medium) Slot 4: sets out[0] = (@4 == 0). It then evaluates the sub-curves @0x8 and @0xf8 (slot 1) into out+1 and out+3, and the curve @0x1e8 (slot 4) into out[5].

0x97a850.name: ~LaserParticle

0x97be90.name: GetCurveTypes

0x97c440.name: AccumulateScalarKeyBufferSize

0x97c790.name: InterpolateLinear
0x97c790.evidence: (high) Returns v0 + (v1-v0)*(t-f0)/(f1-f0) over the 8-byte keys i and i+1, with frames masked by 0x3fff.

0x97c800.name: InterpolateStep
0x97c800.evidence: (high) Returns key i+1's value when t is at or past its frame, otherwise key i's value.

0x97c860.name: EvaluateFirstKey
0x97c860.evidence: (medium) Returns the float @4 of the key data, which is the first key's value.

0x97c880.name: EvaluateLastKey
0x97c880.evidence: (medium) Returns the value of the last key, data[count*2-1], where count is header bits 9..24.

0x97c8a0.name: Evaluate
0x97c8a0.evidence: (medium) Slot 4: dispatches through the member-pointer table @0x14a0c48 by header bits 7..8, passing three floats.

0x97c930.name: DiffersFrom

0x97c9a0.name: AccumulateVec3KeyBufferSize
0x97c9a0.evidence: (medium) Same walk as 0x97c440, but for each 'KeyC' (0x4b657943) chunk adds (count-1)*0x10+0x20 to the global @0x14a09d4, i.e. for 16-byte keys.

0x97ca10.name: InterpolateLinearVec3
0x97ca10.evidence: (high) Lerps the three floats @8/@0xc/@0x10 of 16-byte keys i and i+1, using 28-bit frames, into the output float[3].

0x97cac0.name: InterpolateStepVec3
0x97cac0.evidence: (high) Copies key i's or key i+1's three floats to the output, depending on t versus key i+1's frame.

0x97cb20.name: FindKeyIndex
0x97cb20.evidence: (high) Binary search over 16-byte keys for the segment whose 28-bit frame range contains t; returns 0 when none is found.

0x97cbb0.name: EvaluateEmpty
0x97cbb0.evidence: (medium) Fills the output float[3] with the constant @0x1087f04.

0x97cbd0.name: EvaluateFirstKey
0x97cbd0.evidence: (medium) Copies the first key's three floats (data @8/@0xc/@0x10) to the output.

0x97cc10.name: EvaluateLoopBeforeStart
0x97cc10.evidence: (medium) Shifts t before the first frame forward by whole curve lengths and finds the key with 0x97cb20. It then dispatches through the table @0x14a0c90 by the key's type (top 4 bits).

0x97ccd0.name: EvaluateLastKey

0x97cd00.name: EvaluateLoopAfterEnd

0x97cdc0.name: EvaluateInRange
0x97cdc0.evidence: (medium) Calls FindKeyIndex, then the interpolator from the table @0x14a0c90 chosen by the key's type in its top 4 bits.

0x97ce10.name: Evaluate
0x97ce10.evidence: (medium) Slot 1: dispatches through the table @0x14a0ca8 by header bits 7..8 with (t, out).

0x97ce90.name: IsNonDefault

0x97cfe0.name: EvaluateCurve

0x97d020.name: Evaluate

0x97d8c0.evidence: (medium) Returns the signed char @6 (initialised to 0xff by the constructor).

0x97d9b0.evidence: (medium) Returns the signed char @5 (initialised to 0xff by the constructor).

0x97e8b0.name: RemoveChild

0x97e9f0.evidence: (medium) Writes three floats to @0x58..@0x60, the vector UpdateScale copies from @0x98, whose curve defaults to 1.

0x97ea20.name: SetRotation
0x97ea20.evidence: (medium) Writes three floats to @0x64..@0x6c, the vector UpdateRotation copies from @0xa4, whose curve defaults to 0.

0x97ea50.name: SetTranslation

0x97eb00.evidence: (medium) ORs 0x8080000 into @0x1d0, sets the duration @0x1c8 to its float argument and the elapsed @0x1cc to 0. It recurses into all children.

0x97eb90.name: SetTime
0x97eb90.evidence: (medium) Sets both @0x1a8 and @0x1ac to the argument times the scale @0x1bc.

0x97ebf0.name: MarkFinished
0x97ebf0.evidence: (medium) If bit 0x40000 of @0x1d0 is clear, sets it and clears bits 21-26 (mask 0xf81fffff). ~ParametricInstance does the same to its referenced instance.

0x97ec70.name: IsFinished
0x97ec70.evidence: (medium) Returns 1 when bit 0x40000 of @0x1d0 is set and the child list @0x1e0 is empty.

0x97ed20.name: EvaluateTransformCurves
0x97ed20.evidence: (medium) At time @0x1a8/@0x1ac it evaluates the curves from slots 0x18/0x1c/0x20 of the resource @0x1fc into @0x98/@0xa4/@0xb0 (defaults 1/0/0). It also evaluates slot 0x14's curve into @0x88.

0x97ee40.name: ~ParametricInstance

0x97ef70.evidence: (medium) Same as ParametricInstance's but with the resource @0x29c and key bytes @0x256..; outputs go to @0x98/@0xa4/@0xb0/@0x88. Particle vf25/vf26 call it.

0x97f220.name: UpdateScale
0x97f220.evidence: (medium) Calls the handler selected by bit 14 of @0x2ac to fill @0x98, then copies it to @0x58..@0x60.

0x97f260.name: UpdateRotation
0x97f260.evidence: (medium) Calls the handler selected by bit 14 of @0x2ac to fill @0xa4, then copies it to @0x64..@0x6c.

0x97f2c0.name: UpdateCurves
0x97f2c0.evidence: (medium) Calls the handlers selected by bits 14, 10, 11 and 13 of @0x2ac with the time @0x1a8/@0x1ac. It then calls the function pointers @0x2b0, @0x2b4 and @0x2b8; particle vf25/vf28 call it.

0x97f3c0.name: UpdateAndDispatch
0x97f3c0.evidence: (medium) Calls UpdateCurves (0x97f2c0), then vtable slot 0x7c with its 8 arguments.

0x97f7d0.name: EvaluateAnimatedParameters
0x97f7d0.evidence: (medium) Calls the six function pointers @0x2d8..0x2ec with (this, out, t, t2). Called from the vf29 of the Model, LightModel, Decal and DecalRing particle instances.

0x97fad0.name: Update
0x97fad0.evidence: (medium) Calls the function pointer @0x1ec, then the table 0x132f048 entry chosen by bit 22 of @0x1d0. Then calls slot 11 (+0x2c) on each child in the @0x1e0 list.

0x97fb60.name: KillChildrenById
0x97fb60.evidence: (medium) Targets children of type 3 (slot 8) whose @0x1f4 equals the id, and type-3 grandchildren under type-9 children. For each it ORs 0x8080000 into @0x1d0, stores float(time) @0x1c8 and zero @0x1cc, and applies 0x97eb00 to their sub-children. Called by KillClipInstance::vf1.

0x97fcc0.name: Update
0x97fcc0.evidence: (medium) Same body as SchedulerInstance::vf11: calls the function pointer @0x1ec, the bit-22 table 0x132f048, then the children's slot 11.

0x97fd50.name: UpdateGeneration

0xc08fb0.name: QueueSegment
0xc08fb0.evidence: (medium) If the pending queue @0x1bc is empty, the unacked count @0x1b0 is below the window @0x1dc and @0xd8 <= config[3]: bumps @0xd8, clones the segment (slot 1) into the list @0x1ac, starts the retransmit timer @0x108 with config[9] for types 0/1/4/5, and sends with SendSegment. 0xc090e0.name: DeliverInOrderSegments

0xc092a0.name: Close

0xc09570.name: RemoveChildConnection

0xc09b50.name: HandleAckSegment
0xc09b50.evidence: (medium) Thunk forwarding its segment to ProcessAck (0xc09930).

0xc0a320.evidence: (medium) ReceivePacket's type 0 handler. 0xc0a5d0.name: SendAck
0xc0a5d0.evidence: (high) Calls SendExtendedAck when out-of-order segments are held (@0x1c8). Otherwise, if the pending-ack count @0xd0 is non-zero, it clears it and sends an ACKSegment (0x640, ack @0xcc) via FUN_00c08780.

0xc0a8a0.name: HandleSynSegment

0xc0aaa0.name: HandleRstSegment

0xc0ad40.name: HandleNulSegment

0xc0afb0.name: ReceivePacket
