0xc84570.name: Run
0xc84570.evidence: (high) Stores the start time @0x14/@0x18 and calls Pause (slot +0x14) when stopped. When not already running it calls slot +0x1c (Run) on each connected pin with the start time, then sets the state @8 to 2.

0xc84650.name: StreamTime
0xc84650.evidence: (high) Vtable slot 4: returns VFW_E_NO_CLOCK without the clock @0x18. Otherwise gets the clock's time and subtracts the start time @0x20/@0x24.

0xc84690.name: FindPin
0xc84690.evidence: (high) Looks through the pins for the one whose name @0x14 matches its argument (lstrcmpW) and returns its interface at +0xc AddRef'd. Returns 0x80040216 (VFW_E_NOT_FOUND) when there is none.

0xc84740.name: QueryVendorInfo
0xc84740.evidence: (medium) Returns E_NOTIMPL (0x80004001) and does nothing else.

0xc84750.name: NotifyEvent
0xc84750.evidence: (high) Forwards the event to the sink @0x44 through its slot 3, and for event code 1 (EC_COMPLETE) passes this+0xc as the parameter. Returns E_NOTIMPL when there is no sink.

0xc84790.name: ReconnectPin
0xc84790.evidence: (high) Queries the graph @0x40 for a second interface (DAT_01095bd4) and calls its slot 0x4c (ReconnectEx) with the pin and media type. When that query fails it calls the graph's slot +0x20 (Reconnect) with the pin.

0xc84820.name: ~CEnumPins
0xc84820.evidence: (medium) Sets vtable 0x1128a54, releases the interface at +0xc of the object @0xc, then destroys the list at +0x18 with 0xc8df10.

0xc84840.name: QueryInterface
0xc84840.evidence: (high) Returns E_POINTER for a null ppv. Compares riid with two IIDs (IEnumPins and IUnknown, the latter @0x1082374) and calls GetInterface, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE 0x80004002.

0xc848c0.name: Release
0xc848c0.evidence: (high) InterlockedDecrement on @0x14; at zero it calls the deleting destructor (vtable slot 0x1c) with 1.

0xc848f0.name: Skip
0xc848f0.evidence: (high) Compares the filter's version (slot 0x14 of @0xc) with @0x10 and returns 0x80040203 when they differ. Otherwise it advances the position @4 bounded by the count @8, returning S_FALSE when that bound is exceeded.

0xc84940.name: Reset
0xc84940.evidence: (high) Re-reads the version (slot 0x14) into @0x10 and the pin count (slot 0x18) into @8, zeroes the position @4 and clears the pin cache list @0x18.

0xc84980.name: Refresh
0xc84980.evidence: (medium) Same as Reset (version @0x10, count @8, position @4 = 0) but does not clear the pin cache.

0xc849d0.name: QueryInterface
0xc849d0.evidence: (high) Same pattern as CEnumPins::QueryInterface but with the IID @0x10959c4 (IEnumMediaTypes) or IUnknown, then GetInterface.

0xc84a50.name: Release
0xc84a50.evidence: (high) InterlockedDecrement on @0x10; at zero it calls the deleting destructor (slot 0x1c).

0xc84a80.name: Next
0xc84a80.evidence: (high) Checks the version against @0xc, then for up to cTypes entries calls the pin's GetMediaType (slot 0x34) with the position @4. Each type is copied into a CoTaskMemAlloc(0x48) AM_MEDIA_TYPE and the number fetched is written out.

0xc84bc0.name: Skip
0xc84bc0.evidence: (high) Checks the version, advances the position @4 by cSkip and probes GetMediaType (slot 0x34) at position-1, returning S_FALSE when that call fails.

0xc84c60.name: Reset
0xc84c60.evidence: (high) Zeroes the position @4 and stores the pin's media type version (slot 0x10) in @0xc.

0xc84c90.name: ~CBasePin
0xc84c90.evidence: (high) Frees the name @0x14, destroys the CMediaType @0x34, then runs the base (CUnknown) destructor.

0xc84cb0.name: NonDelegatingQueryInterface
0xc84cb0.evidence: (high) One IID (IID_IPin) returns the interface at this+0xc and another (IID_IQualityControl) returns this+0x10; any other IID goes to the base NonDelegatingQueryInterface.

0xc84d50.name: NonDelegatingAddRef
0xc84d50.evidence: (high) Forwards to AddRef on the owning filter @0x28 (its IUnknown at +0xc).

0xc84d70.name: NonDelegatingRelease
0xc84d70.evidence: (high) Forwards to Release on the owning filter @0x28 (its IUnknown at +0xc).

0xc84d90.name: AttemptConnection
0xc84d90.evidence: (high) Calls CheckConnect, CheckMediaType, stores the receive pin @0x18, then SetMediaType, the peer's ReceiveConnection and CompleteConnect. On failure it breaks the connection, releases @0x18 and maps errors to 0x8004022a.

0xc84e60.name: TryMediaTypes
0xc84e60.evidence: (high) Resets the IEnumMediaTypes, then walks it one type at a time, filtering on a partial type (FUN_00c8e2c0) and trying each with an inlined AttemptConnection. Returns 0x80040207 when no type is accepted.

0xc85000.name: AgreeMediaType
0xc85000.evidence: (high) A fully specified type goes straight to AttemptConnection. Otherwise it tries the receive pin's EnumMediaTypes and its own, in an order set by the flag @0x26, through TryMediaTypes.

0xc850f0.name: SetMediaType
0xc850f0.evidence: (high) Assigns the given type to the CMediaType @0x34 and returns S_OK unless that assignment fails.

0xc85110.name: CheckConnect
0xc85110.evidence: (high) Calls the peer's QueryDirection (slot 0x24) and returns 0x80040208 when it equals this pin's direction @0x1c.

0xc85150.name: ReceiveConnection
0xc85150.evidence: (high) IPin method (this = pin+0xc). Under the lock it fails with 0x80040204 when already connected and 0x80040224 when the filter is running, then runs CheckConnect/CheckMediaType/SetMediaType/CompleteConnect.

0xc852b0.name: DisconnectInternal
0xc852b0.evidence: (high) Returns S_FALSE when nothing is connected at @0x18. Otherwise it calls BreakConnect (slot 0x2c), releases the connected pin and clears @0x18.

0xc852f0.name: ConnectedTo
0xc852f0.evidence: (high) IPin method: returns the connected pin (iface+0xc, i.e. 0x18) AddRef'd, or 0x80040209 when not connected.

0xc85330.name: ConnectionMediaType
0xc85330.evidence: (high) Under the lock it copies m_mt (iface+0x28, i.e. 0x34) into the caller's AM_MEDIA_TYPE. When not connected it zeroes that struct and returns 0x80040209.

0xc85390.name: QueryDirection
0xc85390.evidence: (high) IPin method: writes the direction (iface+0x10, i.e. 0x1c) to the out pointer.

0xc853c0.name: QueryId
0xc853c0.evidence: (high) Calls FUN_00c89740 (AMGetWideString) with the pin name (iface+8, i.e. 0x14) and the out pointer.

0xc853e0.name: QueryAccept
0xc853e0.evidence: (high) Calls CheckMediaType (slot 0x20) and returns S_FALSE when it fails.

0xc854b0.name: Notify
0xc854b0.evidence: (medium) Returns E_NOTIMPL. It takes 8 dwords: this, the sender and a 24-byte Quality struct passed by value, matching IQualityControl::Notify.

0xc854c0.name: NewSegment
0xc854c0.evidence: (high) IPin method: stores tStart, tStop (two REFERENCE_TIMEs) and dRate at iface+0x74..0x84, i.e. pin 0x80, 0x88 and 0x90.

0xc85520.name: CheckConnect
0xc85520.evidence: (high) Performs the direction check (0x80040208), then QueryInterfaces the peer for IID @0x1095aa4 (IMemInputPin) into @0x9c.

0xc85570.name: BreakConnect
0xc85570.evidence: (high) Decommits (slot 0x18) and releases the allocator @0x98, then releases the input pin @0x9c, clearing both.

0xc855d0.name: InitAllocator
0xc855d0.evidence: (high) Calls CoCreateInstance(CLSID_MemoryAllocator, NULL, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_IMemAllocator) into the out pointer.

0xc855f0.name: DecideAllocator
0xc855f0.evidence: (high) Takes the input pin's allocator requirements (slot 0x14) and tries the input pin's GetAllocator with DecideBufferSize (slot 0x3c) and NotifyAllocator. If that fails it retries with InitAllocator (slot 0x48).

0xc85700.name: GetDeliveryBuffer
0xc85700.evidence: (high) Calls GetBuffer (slot 0x1c) on the allocator @0x98, or returns E_NOINTERFACE when there is none.

0xc85740.name: Deliver
0xc85740.evidence: (high) Calls Receive (slot 0x18) on the IMemInputPin @0x9c, or returns 0x80040209 when it is not set.

0xc85770.name: DeliverEndOfStream
0xc85770.evidence: (high) Calls IPin::EndOfStream (slot 0x38) on the connected pin @0x18, or returns 0x80040209 when not connected.

0xc857d0.name: EndOfStream
0xc857d0.evidence: (medium) Returns E_UNEXPECTED with only this as argument, as strmbase's output-pin EndOfStream does; chosen from its position after DeliverEndOfStream.

0xc85840.name: DeliverNewSegment
0xc85840.evidence: (high) Returns VFW_E_NOT_CONNECTED (0x80040209) when the connected pin @0x18 is null. Otherwise calls that pin's slot 17 (0x44), IPin::NewSegment, with two 64-bit times and a double rate.

0xc85880.name: ~CBaseInputPin
0xc85880.evidence: (medium) Releases the allocator @0x9c and clears it. Then does the CBasePin teardown: frees the name @0x14, destroys the media type @0x34 (0xc8e460) and runs the base destructor 0xc83a60.

0xc858c0.name: NonDelegatingQueryInterface
0xc858c0.evidence: (high) For the IID @0x1095aa4 (IMemInputPin) it returns the interface at this+0x98 through GetInterface (0xc83ae0). Any other IID goes to the base QI 0xc84cb0.

0xc85920.name: GetAllocator
0xc85920.evidence: (high) Runs under the pin's lock (iface-0x78). If there is no allocator it creates one with CoCreateInstance(CLSID_MemoryAllocator, IID_IMemAllocator) into the field at iface+4, then AddRefs it into the out pointer; E_POINTER when the out pointer is null.

0xc859a0.name: NotifyAllocator
0xc859a0.evidence: (high) Under the lock it AddRefs the new allocator, stores it at iface+4 and releases the old one. Stores the read-only byte at iface+8; E_POINTER when the allocator is null.

0xc85a00.name: BreakConnect
0xc85a00.evidence: (high) If the allocator @0x9c is set, calls its Decommit (slot 0x18) and returns on failure. Otherwise releases it and clears the field.

0xc85a40.name: Receive
0xc85a40.evidence: (high) Checks streaming first, then reads the sample's 0x30-byte AM_SAMPLE2_PROPERTIES through IMediaSample2 (or builds them from IMediaSample getters). On a media-type change that the pin rejects it raises a runtime error (0x8004022a) and returns 0x80040200. Called by TextureRenderer vf38.

0xc85bb0.name: ReceiveMultiple
0xc85bb0.evidence: (high) Loops over the sample array, calling Receive (slot 0x18) on each and counting the processed samples into *param_4. Stops at the first non-zero result; E_POINTER when the array is null.

0xc85c00.name: ReceiveCanBlock
0xc85c00.evidence: (high) Enumerates the filter's pins through GetPinCount/GetPin (slots 0x18/0x1c). For output pins (direction 1) it takes ConnectedTo, QIs IMemInputPin and calls its ReceiveCanBlock (slot 0x20).

0xc85d00.name: EndFlush
0xc85d00.evidence: (medium) Under the lock it clears the flushing flag (pin+0xa1) and the runtime-error flag (pin+0x24); returns S_OK.

0xc85d80.name: GetAllocatorRequirements
0xc85d80.evidence: (medium) Takes this plus one argument and returns E_NOTIMPL (0x80004001).

0xc85d90.name: CheckStreaming
0xc85d90.evidence: (high) Returns VFW_E_WRONG_STATE (0x80040227) when the filter state (filter+0x14) is stopped and S_FALSE while flushing (@0xa1). Otherwise returns VFW_E_RUNTIME_ERROR (0x8004020b) if @0x24 is set, else S_OK.

0xc85dc0.name: PassNotify
0xc85dc0.evidence: (high) Sends the Quality to the quality sink @0x2c through its Notify, or else QIs the connected pin @0x18 for IQualityControl and calls Notify(filter+0xc, q). Returns VFW_E_NOT_FOUND (0x80040216) otherwise.

0xc85eb0.name: QueryInterface
0xc85eb0.evidence: (high) Accepts three IIDs (IMediaSample, IMediaSample2, IUnknown) through GetInterface. Otherwise sets the out pointer to null and returns E_NOINTERFACE.

0xc85f40.name: Release
0xc85f40.evidence: (high) Decrements the count @0x44. At zero it clears the media type (if flag 8 is set), the flags @4/@8 and the stream id @0x40, then calls the allocator's ReleaseBuffer (allocator@0x18 +0xc, slot 0x20).

0xc85fa0.name: SetPointer
0xc85fa0.evidence: (high) Stores the buffer @0xc and the size into both @0x10 and @0x14. Returns VFW_E_BUFFER_OVERFLOW (0x8004020d) for a negative size.

0xc85fd0.name: GetPointer
0xc85fd0.evidence: (high) Writes the buffer pointer @0xc to the out parameter.

0xc86000.name: GetTime
0xc86000.evidence: (high) With flag 0x100 it returns the start @0x20 and end @0x28. With only flag 0x10 it returns start and start+1 with VFW_S_NO_STOP_TIME (0x40270); otherwise VFW_E_SAMPLE_TIME_NOT_SET (0x80040249).

0xc86070.name: SetTime
0xc86070.evidence: (high) Sets the start @0x20 and/or end @0x28 together with the time-valid flags 0x10/0x100. A null start clears both flags.

0xc860e0.name: GetMediaTime
0xc860e0.evidence: (high) Needs flag 0x20, else returns 0x80040251. Returns the media start @0x30 and start plus the delta @0x38.

0xc86120.name: SetMediaTime
0xc86120.evidence: (high) Stores the media start @0x30 and the end-start delta @0x38 and sets flag 0x20; a null start clears the flag.

0xc86170.name: IsSyncPoint
0xc86170.evidence: (medium) Returns S_OK when flag bit 1 @4 is set, S_FALSE otherwise.

0xc861b0.name: IsDiscontinuity
0xc861b0.evidence: (medium) Returns S_OK when flag bit 4 @4 is set.

0xc861f0.name: IsPreroll
0xc861f0.evidence: (medium) Returns S_OK when flag bit 2 @4 is set.

0xc86240.name: SetActualDataLength
0xc86240.evidence: (high) Stores a length in 0..size(@0x14) into @0x10; otherwise returns VFW_E_BUFFER_OVERFLOW.

0xc86270.name: GetMediaType
0xc86270.evidence: (high) Returns S_FALSE with null when flag 8 is clear. Otherwise returns a copy of the type @0x3c made by 0xc8e6a0 (CreateMediaType), or E_OUTOFMEMORY if that fails.

0xc862b0.name: SetMediaType
0xc862b0.evidence: (high) Frees the old type @0x3c (0xc8e650) and stores a copy of the new one. Sets or clears flag 8; E_OUTOFMEMORY when the copy fails.

0xc86310.name: GetProperties
0xc86310.evidence: (high) Builds an AM_SAMPLE2_PROPERTIES from the fields and copies up to 0x30 bytes to the caller.

0xc863c0.name: SetProperties
0xc863c0.evidence: (high) Validates an AM_SAMPLE2_PROPERTIES of up to 0x30 bytes (E_INVALIDARG 0x80070057), then applies the flags, type flags, length, times, stream id and media type by size.

0xc86550.name: ~CDynamicOutputPin
0xc86550.evidence: (medium) Resets four vftables (including the interface @0xa0), closes the event handles @0xbc/@0xc0 and deletes the critical section @0xa4. Then runs the CBasePin teardown (name @0x14, media type @0x34, 0xc83a60).

0xc865f0.name: NonDelegatingQueryInterface
0xc865f0.evidence: (medium) For the IID @0x1096124 it returns the interface at this+0xa0 through GetInterface; any other IID goes to the base QI 0xc84cb0.

0xc86650.name: Disconnect
0xc86650.evidence: (medium) Under the pin lock: returns S_FALSE when not connected (iface+0xc). Otherwise calls BreakConnect (slot 0x2c), releases the connected pin and clears it; there is no stopped-state check.

0xc866c0.name: BlockOutputPin
0xc866c0.evidence: (high) Resets the unblock event @0xbc, sets and closes the notify-caller event @0xc0, then sets the block state @0xc4 = 2 (BLOCKED) and clears @0xc0; this matches strmbase's BlockOutputPin.

0xc86700.name: UnblockOutputPin
0xc86700.evidence: (high) Under the critical section @0xa4: returns 1 if the state @0xc4 is already 0. Otherwise sets the event @0xbc, signals and closes @0xc0, and zeroes @0xc4, @0xc8 and @0xc0.

0xc86780.name: StartUsingOutputPin
0xc86780.evidence: (high) While the state @0xc4 is 2 it waits on the unblock event @0xbc and the stop event @0xd0. Once unblocked it increments the user count @0xcc; a stop returns 0x80040223 (VFW_E_STATE_CHANGED).

0xc86840.name: StopUsingOutputPin
0xc86840.evidence: (high) Decrements the user count @0xcc and calls BlockOutputPin when it reaches 0 while the state @0xc4 is non-zero.

0xc86880.name: StreamingThreadUsingOutputPin
0xc86880.evidence: (high) Returns whether the user count @0xcc is non-zero, read under the lock @0xa4.

0xc868b0.name: SetConfigInfo
0xc868b0.evidence: (high) Stores the graph config pointer @0xd4 and the stop event @0xd0.

0xc868d0.name: Active
0xc868d0.evidence: (high) Returns E_FAIL without the stop event @0xd0 or graph config @0xd4. Otherwise resets the stop event and commits the allocator @0x98 (slot 0x14), returning VFW_E_NO_ALLOCATOR when there is none.

0xc86920.name: Inactive
0xc86920.evidence: (high) Sets the stop event @0xd0, clears the byte @0x24 and decommits the allocator @0x98 (slot 0x18).

0xc86950.name: DeliverBeginFlush
0xc86950.evidence: (high) Sets the stop event @0xd0, then calls BeginFlush (slot 0x3c) on the connected pin @0x18; returns VFW_E_NOT_CONNECTED when there is none.

0xc86980.name: DeliverEndFlush
0xc86980.evidence: (high) Resets the stop event @0xd0, then calls EndFlush (slot 0x40) on the connected pin @0x18.

0xc869b0.name: ChangeMediaTypeHelper
0xc869b0.evidence: (medium) Calls ReceiveConnection on the connected pin @0x18, then CheckMediaType (slot 0x24). It then renegotiates the allocator: GetAllocatorRequirements on @0x9c, Decommit, DecideBufferSize (slot 0x3c), Commit, and NotifyAllocator with the flag @0xd8.

0xc86ab0.name: ChangeMediaType
0xc86ab0.evidence: (medium) Calls IGraphConfig::Reconnect (slot 0xc) on @0xd4 with (this pin, 0, pmt, 0, stop event @0xd0, 2).

0xc86b00.name: CompleteConnect
0xc86b00.evidence: (high) Calls DecideAllocator (slot 0x38) with the input pin @0x9c. If the filter @0x28 is not stopped (its state @0x14 is non-zero), commits the allocator @0x98.

0xc86b40.name: WaitEvent
0xc86b40.evidence: (high) WaitForSingleObject with INFINITE: returns 0 when signalled, the last-error HRESULT on WAIT_FAILED, and E_UNEXPECTED otherwise.

0xc86b70.name: ~CBaseAllocator
0xc86b70.evidence: (high) Closes the semaphore @0x30, releases the notify object @0x58, deletes the critical section @0x10 and calls the CUnknown base destructor.

0xc86bb0.name: NonDelegatingQueryInterface
0xc86bb0.evidence: (high) Hands out the interface @+0xc for IID @0x1095a74, or for IID @0x1095a84 only when the flag @0x5c is set. Any other IID goes to the CUnknown base QI.

0xc86c20.name: SetProperties
0xc86c20.evidence: (high) Takes the lock and rejects: alignment != 1 (0x8004020e), committed @0x44 (0x8004020f), and outstanding buffers when @0x30 != @0x20 (0x80040210). Otherwise copies the four properties into @0x2c..@0x3c and into the actual-properties output, then sets the changed flag @0x40.

0xc86d10.name: GetProperties
0xc86d10.evidence: (high) Copies count, size, alignment and prefix from @0x2c/@0x34/@0x38/@0x3c into the output, under the lock.

0xc86d70.name: GetBuffer
0xc86d70.evidence: (high) Pops a sample from the free list @0x1c and decrements the count @0x20, or increments the waiting count and waits on the semaphore @0x24. Returns 0x80040211 when not committed and 0x8004022e with flag 4; the sample's @0x44 is set to 1 on return.

0xc86e10.name: SetNotify
0xc86e10.evidence: (high) AddRefs the new notify object, releases the old one @0x4c and stores the new one there.

0xc86e60.name: GetFreeCount
0xc86e60.evidence: (high) Writes count @0x2c - allocated @0x30 + free count @0x20 to the output.

0xc86ea0.name: NotifySample
0xc86ea0.evidence: (high) Releases the semaphore @0x30 by the waiting count @0x34, then zeroes that count.

0xc86ec0.name: Commit
0xc86ec0.evidence: (high) When not committed (@0x44) sets committed; unless a decommit is pending (@0x48) it calls Alloc (slot 0x14) and AddRef, rolling back on failure.

0xc86f50.name: Decommit
0xc86f50.evidence: (high) Clears committed; calls Free (slot 0x10) when all samples are back (@0x30 <= @0x20), else marks a decommit pending. Then releases waiters on the semaphore and Releases.

0xc87020.name: Remove
0xc87020.evidence: (high) Unlinks the given sample from the singly linked list (next pointer @0x1c of each sample) and decrements the count @4.

0xc87060.name: SetProperties
0xc87060.evidence: (high) Uses GetSystemInfo's allocation granularity to validate the alignment, then the committed and outstanding-buffer checks. Rounds size+prefix up to the alignment and stores the properties @0x2c..@0x3c.

0xc87190.name: ReallyFree
0xc87190.evidence: (high) Deletes every sample on the free list @0x28 (the sample's slot 0x54 with 1) and zeroes @0x3c, then VirtualFree(MEM_RELEASE) on the buffer @0x60.

0xc871e0.name: ~CMemAllocator
0xc871e0.evidence: (high) Sets the vftables 0x1128bf4/0x1128bc8, calls Decommit and ReallyFree, then does the CBaseAllocator teardown (semaphore @0x30, notify @0x58, critical section).

0xc87230.name: AMovieSetupRegisterFilter2
0xc87230.evidence: (medium) With IFilterMapper2-style slots: UnregisterFilter (0x1c) on the CLSID, then when registering RegisterFilter (0xc) and pins/types per 0x24-byte pin entry. 0x80070002 is mapped to 0.

0xc87410.name: CBaseFilter
0xc87410.evidence: (high) The constructor: CUnknown base, then zeroes state @0x14, clock @0x18 and start time @0x20. Copies the CLSID into @0x28, the lock into @0x38, and sets the pin version @0x48 = 1.

0xc87470.name: QueryFilterInfo
0xc87470.evidence: (high) Copies the filter name @0x30 (up to 128 wchar_t) into the info and stores the graph @0x34 at info+0x100 with an AddRef.

0xc87500.name: JoinFilterGraph
0xc87500.evidence: (high) Under the lock @0x2c stores the graph @0x34 and QIs the sink @0x38 with IID 0x1095b54. Replaces the name @0x30 with a copy of the new name.

0xc875f0.name: Register
0xc875f0.evidence: (high) Gets the setup data via slot 0x20, then CoInitialize and CoCreateInstance of the filter mapper. Calls AMovieSetupRegisterFilter2(..., 1).

0xc87660.name: Unregister
0xc87660.evidence: (high) Same as Register but calls AMovieSetupRegisterFilter2 with 0, returning 0 for 0x80070002.

0xc876e0.name: CEnumPins
0xc876e0.evidence: (high) The constructor: vftable 0x1128a54, filter @0xc AddRef'd, and the pin list @0x18. Copies position/count/version from the enumerator being cloned, or reads them from the filter's slots 0x14/0x18.

0xc87770.name: Clone
0xc87770.evidence: (high) Checks the filter's pin version against @0x10 (else 0x80040203), then allocates 0x30 bytes and constructs a CEnumPins from this.

0xc877e0.name: Next
0xc877e0.evidence: (high) Resyncs on a pin-version change. Fetches pins via the filter's GetPin (slot 0x1c), skipping ones already in the list @0x18, and AddRefs each pin's interface.

0xc878e0.name: CEnumMediaTypes
0xc878e0.evidence: (high) The constructor: vftable 0x1128a74, pin @8 AddRef'd, and the version @0xc from the pin's slot 0x10 or copied from the enumerator being cloned.

0xc87940.name: Clone
0xc87940.evidence: (high) Checks the version, then allocates 0x14 bytes and constructs a CEnumMediaTypes copy.

0xc879b0.name: CBasePin
0xc879b0.evidence: (high) The constructor: CUnknown base, filter @0x28, lock @0x20, direction @0x1c, and the media type @0x34. Stores the stop time 0x7fffffffffffffff and rate 1.0 @0x90, and copies the pin name into @0x14.

0xc87a90.name: Connect
0xc87a90.evidence: (high) On the IPin interface (this+0xc): NULL pin gives E_POINTER. Under the lock @+0x14 it returns 0x80040204 when connected (@+0xc) and 0x80040224 when the filter is not stopped and @+0x19 is 0, else calls AgreeMediaType (0xc85000) and on failure the cleanup slot 0x2c.

0xc87b30.name: Disconnect

0xe1c560.evidence: (medium) Calls GetValue, requires the value to be enclosed in '"' quotes, strips them, parses with ParseInt64 and stores the low 32 bits.

0xe1c5d0.name: HasAttribute
0xe1c5d0.evidence: (medium) Returns a bool that is true when GetValue succeeds.

0xe1c600.name: GetUintAttribute
0xe1c600.evidence: (medium) Takes the quoted attribute value from GetValue, strips the quotes and parses it with ParseUint (hex or decimal).

0xe1c660.name: PushLexeme
0xe1c660.evidence: (medium) Appends an 8-byte range to the array @0x68/@0x6c/@0x70 holding the current lexeme offsets (@0x44 - @0x40, @0x48 - @0x4c - @0x40).

0xe1c720.name: ExtractAttributes
0xe1c720.evidence: (medium) Clears the map @8 and keys @0x18, then copies every other lexeme from index 1 as a NUL-terminated name into the char buffer @0x24. Each name is mapped to its value lexeme index.

0xe1c830.name: ParseBlock
0xe1c830.evidence: (medium) Reads tokens from the lexer @0x30: a name, then name = value pairs, ended by token 6 or by 0xb then 6. Returns token type 1/2/3/6 (start, empty element, end, error).

0xe1c950.name: ParseNext
0xe1c950.evidence: (medium) Resets the keys, the map and the lexeme array, then switches on the first lexer token: 0 goes to ParseBlock, 1 to ParseQBlock, 2/3/5 map to 4/5/7, and 4 (whitespace) is skipped.

0xe1c9e0.name: Advance
0xe1c9e0.evidence: (medium) Calls ParseNext and stores the token in @0x74.

0xe1c9f0.name: Dump
0xe1c9f0.evidence: (medium) Loops on Advance, writing each token to the stream (blocks through DumpBlock, text through GetLexeme), until token 6 or 7.

0xe1cc10.name: ExpandOne
0xe1cc10.evidence: (medium) Grows the 8-byte-element array through the given allocator when full, increments the size and returns a pointer to the new element.

0xe1cc50.name: ExpandOneDefault
0xe1cc50.evidence: (medium) Same as ExpandOne but uses the container heap allocator 0x13516ac.

0xe1cc80.name: DeleteReferencedObject2
0xe1cc80.evidence: (medium) Same body as 0xe1bfa0: the TLS router's allocator slot 2 is called with (obj, u16 size @obj+4).

0xe1ce50.name: GetClassInfo
0xe1ce50.evidence: (medium) Fills the out struct from the impl's slots 2 and 3, the parent's name (slot 4, then its slot 2) and the member count (slot 6). It grows the 12-byte array @+0xc and fetches each member through slot 7.

0xe1d060.name: AssignValueToObject
0xe1d060.evidence: (medium) Switches on the member type: 2/4 int, 3 real, 5 string, 6/7 ref-counted object, 9 real tuple. Each case reads the source value through a getter and calls the matching setter slot (0x44, 0x50, 0x54, 0x5c, 0x48) of param_1; called by hkDataObjectNative::vf24.

0xe1d1b0.name: AssignValueToArrayItem
0xe1d1b0.evidence: (medium) Same type switch as 0xe1d060 but uses the array's setter slots 0x50/0x40/0x38/0x60/0x68/0x30. Called by StructArrayImplementation::vf24 and its Object::vf24.

0xe1d390.name: FillPairs
0xe1d390.evidence: (medium) Copies the 8-byte value param_3 into param_2 consecutive 8-byte slots starting at param_1.

0xe1d3c0.name: ApplyLocalAndGlobal
0xe1d3c0.evidence: (medium) For each 8-byte local fixup @0 it writes base+to at base+from. For each 16-byte global fixup @0xc it writes the stored address at base+from.

0xe1d410.name: AddImport
0xe1d410.evidence: (medium) Lazily allocates a 0x10-byte string map @0x30 through the TLS memory router and interns the name in it, duplicating it with FUN_00da0f10 when new. It then pushes (offset, pooled string) onto the 8-byte array @0x24.

0xe1d4f0.name: ~hkRelocationInfo
0xe1d4f0.evidence: (medium) Destroys and frees the 0x10-byte pool @0x30. It then frees the arrays @0x24 (8-byte), @0x18 (8-byte), @0xc (16-byte) and @0 (8-byte), resetting each to 0 / 0x80000000; called by hkPlatformObjectWriter::vf3 and others.

0xe1d5f0.name: PushBack8WithAllocator
0xe1d5f0.evidence: (medium) Grows the array by 8-byte elements through the given allocator when size @4 equals capacity @8 & 0x3fffffff. It then appends the 8-byte value and increments the size.

0xe1d630.name: PushBack8
0xe1d630.evidence: (medium) Same as 0xe1d5f0 but always uses the default heap allocator @0x13516ac.

0xe1d670.name: RouterAllocate
0xe1d670.evidence: (medium) Calls the allocator in the thread's TLS memory router (+0x2c), slot 1, with the given size.

0xe1d6c0.name: ScalarDeletingDestructor
0xe1d6c0.evidence: (medium) Calls FUN_00df5070 and FUN_00da3e20 (the same teardown hkRelocationInfo applies to its pool). When flag bit 0 is set it frees 0x10 bytes through the TLS router.

0xe1dba0.name: DeallocateReferencedObject

0xe1dbd0.name: AllocateReferencedObject

0xe1dc00.name: AllocateReferencedObject2

0xe1dc30.name: DeallocateReferencedObject2

0xe1e770.evidence: (medium) Doubles from 8 until the value is >= count*2, then returns that times 0xc bytes.

0xe1ee40.name: CopyField
0xe1ee40.evidence: (medium) Handles one 0x10-byte field descriptor. Array fields (type 8, or type 9 without subtype 3) are resized and copied with CopyArrayElements; other fields go through FUN_00e1ff00.

0xe1f040.evidence: (medium) Constructor: stores dst @0 and src @4, and initialises the map @8 to (0, 0, mask -1).

0xe1f070.evidence: (medium) Runs if the destination registry lacks type id param_1 (slot 0x24). It collects the type and its ancestors from the source registry into a 0x18-byte vector. It registers them in reverse order with remapped field type ids (FUN_00e1aff0) via slot 0xc, then recurses for fields of kind 6.

0xe1f390.evidence: (medium) Fills the vector argument with the destination's field list (slots 0x24/0x30). It reads the source's field list and calls ImportType for each field whose type kind is 6.

0xe1f5c0.name: CloneObject
0xe1f5c0.evidence: (medium) A null source gives null. It looks the source handle up in the map @8 and returns the existing copy if found. Otherwise it imports the type, creates the object in the destination (slot 0x10), records the pair (FUN_00e068a0) and copies its fields.

0xe1f790.name: FreeTypeEntry

0xe1f920.name: Remove

0xe1f9c0.name: Insert
0xe1f9c0.evidence: (medium) Rehashes to (mask*2+2) with FUN_00e07420 when mask < count*2, returning 0 if that rehash reports non-zero. It then inserts with FUN_00e071a0.

0xe1fa20.name: InsertIfAbsent
